UMD momentum factor: Momentum factor identified as UMD and attributed to Carhart (1997); its construction is not stated here.
Pastor–Stambaugh liquidity factor: Liquidity factor attributed to Pastor and Stambaugh (2003); its construction is not stated here.
Risk-adjusted stock return R*_{jt}: R*_{jt} = R_{jt} − RF_t − Σ[k=1..5] β_{jk,t−1} F_{kt}, where RF is the one-year T-bill rate and F_k is factor realization plus associated risk premium.
SIZE: ln(market capitalization in billions of dollars)
BM: log(book equity / market equity at December year-end; log base unreported)
R1: stock return at t−1

R212: Cumulative return over the 11 months ending at the beginning of the previous month (months t−12 through t−2). The paper does not state the compounding/aggregation formula. This characteristic covers months t−12 through t−2 and is already lagged two months for the monthly Fama–MacBeth regression. All explanatory variables are winsorized monthly at the 0.005 and 0.995 fractiles, then standardized in each monthly cross-section to zero mean and unit standard deviation.
TURN: log(monthly trading volume / total shares outstanding; log base unreported)
ILLIQ: ILLIQ_it = (1/D_it) * sum[d=1..D_it](abs(R_itd)/DVOL_itd) * 10^6
ACC: (Δ non-cash current assets − Δ current liabilities excluding short-term debt and taxes payable − depreciation expense) / average total assets
AG: year-on-year percentage change in total assets (the source does not state a separate display scaling)

ISSUE: Change in shares outstanding from 11 months ago. The source does not report a denominator or further scaling. For the monthly Fama–MacBeth regression, this characteristic is lagged two months. PROFIT: income before extraordinary items / book equity
